notes.title: Patch 0.0.0.4.25 - Daily Quest & Sushi!
notes.content:
+More

This is a normal update with a big new feature and some smaller stuff as well.

[Daily Quest]
The daily system will have 3 tiers of quests, boops, play minigames, and play a certain minigame.  After completing all 3 you will be rewarded a random reward for the day.  It can be cat coins, hairballs, yarnballs, worm tokens, and gacha boxes. (for now)  I plan to keep it updated and add new rewards and quests.

[New Clothing]
Hats:
Anime Headband
Vocal Hair
Anime Glasses
Ramen Bowl
Ninja Cat Headband
Future Mascot Mask
Rain Hat

Ties:
Anime Bows x6

Socks:
Anime Moon Boots
Anime Taboo Metal Limbs

[Sushi Effect]
Sushi now has a use!
Clicking on it will start a frenzy of sushi raining from the gods.  It will increase your boop meter for 20 seconds and make it 4 times faster.  And make your cat happier than ever :D

notes.title: Hotfix 0.0.0.3.60 - General Bug Fixes and Some Improvements and Changes
notes.content:
Tried to fix most of the bugs reported!

Bugs Squashed:
Invisible Piano Playing
Pop the Bubble- You can no longer pop them off-screen.
Adventure Mode Demo - The shop can no longer be opened and closed while talking to NPCs.
Adventure Mode Demo - The text box now instant shows on the first click and closes the box on the second click.
The Cat Meow volume has been adjusted, and some of the music that was very low compared to others.
The Shop Cardboard Box has been fixed up, as some items were set to the wrong values.  (So it would show an item and not unlock it and unlock something else :D)  Sorry about that.

Quality Changes:
Yarnpocalypse - Clothing Set 1 crafting cost has been adjusted :D

New Required Items:
Yarn Hat - 50 Yarnballs + Cat Coins
Yarn Tie - 25 Yarnballs + Cat Coins
Yarn Socks - 75 Yarnballs + Cat Coins

Pop the Bubble - Highscore added to the main screen as well :D

As always, enjoy the update and please let me know if there are any issues.

notes.title: Hotfix - 0.0.0.3.10 - Fixes and Difficulty Adjustments
notes.content:
Made Catch the Mouse a bit tighter on the timer for the good rewards.  

Adjusted the Yarn speeds on Yarnpocalypse minigame to make it more playable.  

Fishing areas now appear after completing the catalog properly.  The fishing minigame goal bar now updates and gets a little harder with each area you progress.  Exclamation bug for the QuickTime fishing event has been fixed.  All fishing currency now shows all the time despite having the areas unlocked.

Cat Toys you can now cycle without missing a beat :D  All options show properly now.
